title: Building access.
officialText: Provisions shall be made for access by the Fire Department to every building in accordance with Section 903.2.11.1 of this code and Chapter 5 of the New York City Fire Code. In addition, multiple dwellings shall comply with Section 54 of the New York State Multiple Dwelling Law, as applicable.
